content.text: Each person playing, you know, one frame at a time. That's right. And now actually the other thing about it is it's very funny to see people trying to bowl or play.

content.text: Or maybe with the heavy ball or maybe they they pass the line that we said they shouldn't pass and they slip and fall.
content.trans: 英语：或者可能是用重物或可能他们违反了我们说的不应该通过的规定，然后摔倒了。

content.text: So I guess that's what also makes it a little bit fun to play.
content.trans: 所以我觉得这有点儿像玩，也挺有意思的。

content.text: Yes, it can be a little bit embarrassing if you're not I'm not very good. So I'm a very embarrassing bowler.
content.trans: 是的，如果你们不那么好，那我是个很尴尬的球手。

content.text: But it's also really fun because if you go and you just, you know, have a nice time and it's it's a very social game.
content.trans: 但是它还真的很有趣，因为你去玩，你就会有好心情，而且这是一个非常社交的游戏。

content.text: Well, it is. And and actually we are really curious to know if you've ever been bowling.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，是的。而且实际上我们真的非常好奇你是否曾经打过 bowling。

content.text: I know many people have never been bowling and they find it very, very fun. So why don't you come to our website,
content.trans: 我认识很多人从未玩过 bowling，他们觉得玩得很开心。所以，为什么不来看看我们的网站呢？

content.text: EnglishPod.com and leave your questions and comments there as well.
content.trans: 英语：它也是一个点和拍相机。

content.text: Yeah, we hope to see you there until next time guys. Bye.
content.trans: 英语：是啊，我们希望下次见面时能看到你。再见！
